title: One set of controls, in the same places, in every game
kaylee: Back is always top left, the way on is always bottom right, and every button is drawn in the game's own style.
questions: Is lavender right for every "again" button, or did you like the mint one at the board games?
In the mall games the way on now pops in bottom right instead of top centre. Does she find it?

pictures.title: Mall games: one back button
pictures.caption: Top left goes back to the hall. The sticker strip sits beside it, not under it.

pictures.title: Campfire: one row of stars
pictures.caption: Stars are the orders she is toasting; the pink dashes are the parts of the game.

pictures.title: Board games: leave is top left
pictures.caption: The waving hand is gone. The games button is drawn, top right.

pictures.title: Trophy and again buttons
pictures.caption: Drawn again and home pictures instead of emoji, everywhere there is an again.

pictures.title: The end card
pictures.caption: Small again, big way on. The boat race, the Nan roads and the farm stops all end like this.
